name: Park Village
summary: Park Village is Southlake's upscale lifestyle center featuring a curated mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options in an open-air village setting. Located in one of Texas's wealthiest communities, the center serves as a premier gathering place with a 4.5-star rating and nearly 1,000 reviews.
demographics: Park Village attracts an affluent demographic reflective of Southlake's status as one of the wealthiest communities in Texas, with median household incomes exceeding $200,000. The primary visitor base consists of families with children, professionals aged 30-55, and retirees who appreciate upscale shopping and dining in an open-air environment. The trade area draws from Southlake's highly educated population, with many residents working in executive and professional roles in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Shopping patterns emphasize quality over value, with visitors seeking premium brands, specialty retailers, and elevated dining experiences in a walkable village setting.
description: Park Village stands as Southlake's premier lifestyle destination, offering an inviting blend of shopping, dining, and entertainment in the heart of one of Texas's most affluent communities. Located at 1065 East Southlake Boulevard, this open-air center embodies the sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere that defines Southlake living. The center's tagline, 'Shop, Dine, and Unwind in the Heart of Southlake,' perfectly captures its role as a community gathering place where residents can enjoy upscale retail therapy, savor exceptional cuisine, and relax in a beautifully designed environment. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Park Village accommodates both daytime shoppers and evening diners seeking a refined experience. The center has earned an impressive 4.5-star rating from nearly 1,000 reviews, reflecting its consistent delivery of quality experiences and its importance to the Southlake community as a destination that seamlessly integrates retail, restaurants, and lifestyle amenities.
